records.speaker: Brett Cooper

appearances.snippet: Just a couple of years ago, the New Yorker reported that she also tried to place Courtney Love and Lindsay Lohan into conservatorships

verification.notes: The New Yorker reported two related but materially different allegations: Michael Lohan said Lou Taylor raised the possibility of a conservatorship for Lindsay Lohan, while Courtney Love said Taylor tried to wrest control over her family estate. Taylor denied trying to put Spears, Lohan, or Love into conservatorships. The episode statement accurately cites the article but overstates the Courtney Love allegation by recasting estate control as a conservatorship attempt.

appearances.snippet: Courtney—who is writing a book on this, so I'm not exposing anything—told me that she was given LSD at this age.
She explained to me that she was a toddler and she was experimented on at the Haight-Ashbury Clinic

verification.notes: The episode documents Candace Owens relaying private messages in which Courtney Love said she was experimented on at the Haight-Ashbury Clinic and given LSD as a toddler. In a later on-record interview, Love independently repeated that her father gave her LSD from roughly ages three to six while she lived in Haight-Ashbury. That supports the childhood-LSD portion as a self-report, but no public record reviewed establishes that Love was a clinic experiment or part of a CIA program.
